question: Under what affective condition is one said to be capable of shaking the triple world with all its moving and unmoving things?
premises: Anger is the stated condition for action.
The object is the triple world including moving and unmoving things.
The action is one of shaking.
inference: When angered, one can shake the entire triple world, moving and unmoving alike.
plain_english: When angered, O goddess, one can shake the triple world together with all that moves and does not move.
